inventory_statement: M2 profile families must be declared before endpoint scoring and cannot be selected from held-out performance.
counting_policy: each active profile family or switch privilege must be counted by the later parameter-count table

inventory_statement: Halo/profile parameter slots may be declared here, but no numeric halo parameters are written before scoring gates close.
counting_policy: all declared halo/profile parameters count unless fixed by a source-side public benchmark convention

inventory_statement: Prior widths and bounds must be frozen before scoring and cannot be widened after seeing residuals.
counting_policy: post-freeze prior changes count as endpoint tuning privileges and invalidate the frozen profile slot

inventory_statement: Benchmark profile use is blocked until a separate nuisance policy freezes stellar, gas, uncertainty, and prior-handling rules.
counting_policy: nuisance privileges are counted in the later M2 nuisance and parameter-count gates

inventory_statement: Switching profile families after endpoint inspection is forbidden unless the switch policy was frozen and counted before scoring.
counting_policy: unfrozen profile switching blocks M2 verdict eligibility

inventory_statement: M2 cannot write family prediction rows until nuisance, numeric parameter count, and benchmark value gates are closed.
counting_policy: prediction rows remain blocked and cannot be used as endpoint scores

inventory_statement: Stellar mass-to-light handling must be declared before endpoint scoring and cannot be tuned from held-out residuals.
counting_policy: each fitted or switchable stellar mass-to-light degree of freedom must be counted by the later parameter-count gate

inventory_statement: Gas scaling and baryonic component inclusion rules must be fixed before endpoint residuals are inspected.
counting_policy: gas scaling privileges and component switches are counted if not fixed by a public convention

inventory_statement: Uncertainty handling, error floors, and weighting choices must be frozen before any endpoint family comparison.
counting_policy: post-freeze uncertainty widening invalidates endpoint verdict eligibility

inventory_statement: Nuisance priors must be source-side or publicly predeclared and cannot be widened after seeing endpoint performance.
counting_policy: all nuisance priors with fitted freedom count toward the later numeric parameter-count table

inventory_statement: Baryonic inputs used by M2 must be compatible with the shared scoring-input policy used for every family.
counting_policy: family-specific exceptions must be declared and counted before scoring or the endpoint remains blocked

inventory_statement: M2 cannot write benchmark prediction rows until shared scoring inputs, parameter counts, controls, and thresholds are closed.
counting_policy: prediction rows remain blocked and cannot be used as endpoint scores
